checkpoint_review: The Router correctly identified that the 'Ridge' checkpoint is untestable due to the frontal pose. However, it was perhaps too lenient in marking 'Body is muscular...' as present; while the chest is broad, the fusion of the leg into the chest (noted in artifacts) makes the anatomical definition of the 'muscular' structure ambiguous. The verdicts for Head/Face and Limbs are accurate: the features are either malformed or fused. The Router did not skip any testable checkpoints unfairly.
artifact_review: The Router's severity ratings are well-calibrated. The 'fusion' of the front left leg (Severity 4) is a catastrophic structural failure that dominates the image quality assessment. The 'structural collapse' of the face (Severity 3) is also significant. The 'stick' artifact (Severity 3) further confirms the model's struggle with object interaction and limb boundaries. The topology expert's high confidence mask (0.98) is misleading here; it simply segments the 'blob' of the dog+leg fusion as one object, failing to detect the internal anatomical error. The pose auditor's low confidence in the shoulder/hip regions strongly supports the Router's visual findings of fusion and distortion.
alignment_reasoning: While the fine-grained classifier correctly identifies the breed (Top-1 Rhodesian Ridgeback), this is likely due to the coat color and general shape rather than specific anatomical correctness. The image fails multiple critical checkpoints: Head shape is distorted, Eyes are smudged, and Legs are structurally fused/malformed. The defining feature (Ridge) is untestable. The structural failures in the limbs and face significantly reduce alignment with the 'powerful, athletic, precise' description of the breed.
